human_made_evidence: Kenney (kenney.nl) hand-made assets; master plan §4.1 lists Kenney as stating no generative AI (Kenney also bans generative-AI posts from r/gameassets); poly.pizza profile is a migrated, unclaimed account (2021-04-14); bundle upload dates vary (some 2024), so the human-made basis is Kenney's own no-generative-AI stance, not the date.
bulk_download: Same kits free from kenney.nl (zip, CC0) - preferred bulk route; on poly.pizza: bundle page 'Download FBX' / 'Download GLTF' buttons (manual). Per-model download page only on poly.pizza.
free_tier_only_note: Poly Pizza ToS forbids scraping/automated download ('scrape Content from the Services, or use automated means ... to download data') and any extraction for AI/ML without written permission; model downloads go through a Turnstile check. The Poly Pizza API key terms forbid 'Replicate the service and offer its content to third parties' and commercial API use by a company earning more than $50,000 a year, and require attribution plus a Poly Pizza mention. So StudPilot must not serve files fetched from poly.pizza or its API; take the same CC0/CC-BY files from the creator's own site, or get Poly Pizza's written permission (owner action). The licence on each model itself allows commercial use and redistribution.
